about: Hand-labelled sentences for the faithfulness guard. No third-party text: each entry names its source by item_key, and scripts/eval_faithfulness.py reads the source from the local database. kind=first-digest: the 2026-09-20 card. kind=model: real qwen2.5:7b output from the shipped writer prompt over 12 real items (2026-09-27). kind=perturbation: hand-written, one faithful paraphrase plus deliberate meaning changes per item. label=interpretation: a sentence that makes no claim about the source ('Dies könnte ... nützlich sein'); scored separately. kind=model-heldout: a second writer run over 12 other real items, labelled and scored only AFTER the checker prompt was frozen (v2) - the one number here that was not tuned against. borderline=true marks labels a second reader could reasonably flip.
labelled_by: Claude (autonomous session, 2026-09-27) - not yet reviewed by Nico
